name: bbno$
bio: Alexander Leon Gumuchian , known professionally as bbno$ (pronounced "baby no money"), is a Canadian rapper and singer. He is best known for his 2019 single, "Lalala" (with record producer-songwriter Y2K), which peaked at number ten on the Canadian Hot 100; for his 2021 track "Edamame" (used in several film trailers and soundtracks); and for his collaborations with American rapper Yung Gravy.

credits.title: Priyanka! What's My Name?
credits.overview: After hitting a breaking point, drag superstar Priyanka is forced to reevaluate her life, identity, and relationships.
